subject.title: fix(android): restore the complete Wear companion experience

question: Should OpenClaw support the restored five-page Wear companion UI, including phone-proxied agent/Gateway controls and durable Watch-local theme and Auto-Speak preferences, as the canonical Android companion contract?
rationale: The implementation has bounded protocol safeguards and physical-device evidence, but deciding the supported product scope and durable preference contract is an owner decision rather than a mechanical code repair.

options.title: Approve the companion contract
options.body: Accept the restored UI, capability-gated phone proxy controls, and the two persisted Watch settings as the supported Android/Wear experience.

options.title: Narrow to the current baseline
options.body: Keep only a smaller regression repair and defer agent, Gateway, or durable-preference controls until their product contract is separately approved.

recommendation.title: Approve the companion contract
recommendation.body: Accept the restored UI, capability-gated phone proxy controls, and the two persisted Watch settings as the supported Android/Wear experience.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is directly assigned and is the strongest available routing signal for the remaining product-contract choice.
